Keywords: Early House of Habsburg Red Lion
RagShortTexts: From Habichtsburg Castle in Swiss Aargau, the House of Habsburg steadily accumulated Alpine.

Variants.Content: Originating from Habichtsburg ('Hawk's Castle') in Swiss Aargau, the House of Habsburg displayed a crowned red lion rampant on gold. Count Rudolf I methodically expanded patrimonial estates across Swabia through shrewd marriage contracts, clientage to bishops, and suppressing robber knights during the Great Interregnum.
Viewed by Rhenish electors as an unthreatening minor count, Rudolf quietly built military networks that would soon challenge Ottokar II for the imperial crown.
Habsburg bailiffs enforce predictable manorial tithes without extortion. Count Rudolf personally leads cavalry to hang highwaymen preying on rustic trade routes.
